title: Don’t Judge a Book by its Cover: Testing LLMs’ Robustness Under Logical Obfuscation
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the robustness of LLMs in logical reasoning tasks (First-Order Logic, Blood Relations, Number Series, and Direction Sense) when subjected to structural obfuscation. While it includes an 'Ethics Statement' regarding model access and research guidelines, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics.
